specification.name: Big-five environment ranking layer v1
specification.status: post-outcome exploratory specification; requires untouched validation
specification.purpose: Rank match environments even when teams have not played each other or have little current-season data, while keeping evidence confidence separate from rank.

history.order: Current-season matches first; fill backward with the immediately previous same-league season.
history.promoted_teams: Do not invent or substitute lower-division history. Mark insufficient comparable history.

specification.ranking_method: Within each weekend, percentile-rank the four pre-match components and calculate a 0-100 weighted score. Rank does not use head-to-head results or the target outcome.

confidence_tiers.A: Both teams have at least three current-season matches in the eight-match history.
confidence_tiers.B: Both teams have at least one current-season match, but one or both have fewer than three.
confidence_tiers.C: One or both teams have zero current-season matches; ranking is historical-only.
confidence_tiers.EXCLUDED: Either team lacks at least five comparable matches, or the required home/away shooting histories are unavailable.

specification.candidate_layer: For each ranked fixture, show confirmed home starters with five same-player/same-team starts within 180 days, ranked by average shots. Mark whether at least two of those starts are current-season.
specification.interpretation: Rank and confidence are separate. A high-ranked Tier C match is interesting but not equivalent to a high-confidence selection.

classification: post-outcome exploratory design; not untouched validation
limits: Outcome columns are diagnostic only and never enter ranks.
The weights were designed after viewing earlier carryover results.
Relative percentile scores cannot be compared as absolute probabilities across weekends.
Rank does not equal bet eligibility; confidence must remain visible.
